# CRS Backend — Custom (EMF) Metrics
Qualitative service-behaviour metrics emitted by the CrsBackend Lambdas via EMF (namespace `CrsBackend`), plus a couple of AWS-native Lambda metrics where no EMF metric exists. Complements the `CRS - BACKEND - Lambda` dashboard (infrastructure) with more service-level signal.

**Sections:** Client JWKS · Issue Status · Status Lists · Renew Status Lists · Rotate Signing Keys.

> **NOTES:**
> - Per-`clientId` metric keys (JWKS tiles) are inferred from the EMF dimension names; if a tile shows no data, verify the exact metric key in the Dynatrace metric browser (dimension segments in the auto-generated key can differ).
> - _Renew Status Lists_ counts (renewal threshold, past expiry, unexpected bucket objects) are only emitted when non-zero, so those tiles are empty when there is nothing to report.

tiles.name: Markdown
tiles.markdown:
## Client JWKS
Health of client JWKS fetching/caching. `ClientJwksCacheHit` (dims: clientid, source), `ClientJwksEndpointFailure`, `ClientJwksEndpointResponseLatency`, `ClientJwksKidMiss` (dim: clientid). Cache hit is shown both aggregate and split by clientid.

> **Notes:**
> - Split dimension is `clientid` (lowercase) and Dynatrace metric keys end in `...clientIdservice` — the auto-added `service` dimension is part of the key.
> - **Endpoint Failure** and **Kid Missing** are rare-event metrics: they only emit when a JWKS fetch throws, or when a JWT presents a `kid` not in the cached JWKS. Empty tiles are expected until those events occur — this is not a misconfiguration. Verified against source (`clientJwksCache.ts`, `jwtFunctions.ts`) 2026-09-29: only CacheHit and EndpointResponseLatency have been ingested by Dynatrace.

tiles.customName: JWKS Kid Missing (by clientId) — no data until a JWT presents an unknown kid

## Issue Status
Issuance timing and failures. `IssueStatusAttemptDuration` (ms, per attempt), `IssueStatusFailedAttempts` (count), `IssuedStatusDuration` (s, overarching end-to-end duration, dim: issuer).

> **Note:** duration tiles show **min / avg / max** (p95 preferred but unavailable in Dynatrace). Min is included per requirement.

tiles.name: Issue Status Attempt Duration
tiles.customName: Issue Status Attempt Duration (min / avg / max)

## Status Lists
List health and lifecycle. `StatusListPercentageFill` (%, aggregate — no list-id dim), `StatusListPercentageRevokedFromIssued` (%), `StatusListsPastExpiryThreshold` (count), `StatusListsPastRenewalThreshold` (count).

> **Note:** the % tiles show **min / avg / max** (p95 preferred but unavailable in Dynatrace). Min is included per requirement.

tiles.name: Status List % Fill
tiles.customName: % fill of lists by type — max

## Renew Status Lists
Lifecycle checks from the renew Lambda (`renewStatusListsHandler.ts`): lists approaching the renewal threshold (6 days), lists past the expiry threshold (7 days), and unexpected objects found in the status list bucket. These counts are only emitted when non-zero, so tiles are empty when there is nothing to report.

tiles.customName: Unexpected objects in status list bucket

## Rotate Signing Keys
Signing-key rotation activity. Total invocations uses the AWS-native Lambda invocations metric; last rotation completed tracks the `ROTATE_SIGNING_KEYS_ROTATION_STEP_COMPLETED` message code (EMF). Both mirror the tiles on the `CRS - BACKEND - Lambda` dashboard.

tiles.name: Overall Issued Status Lambda Duration
tiles.customName: Issued Status Duration (overarching, by issuer — min / avg / max)

## Issue / Revoke Counts & Time To Expiry
Credential issue/revoke volumes and revoked-credential lifetime, split by `issuer`. `StatusIssued` (count) and `StatusRevoked` (count) are shown as bar graphs; `RevokedStatusTimeToExpiry` (s) shows min / avg / max of how long a revoked status had left before expiry.
